Co-authored-by: Volkan Yazıcı <volkan.yazici@oracle.com>

Reduce max SO_LINGER value for BSD

The BSD's, like macOS store the SO_LINGER value in a signed short
internally, so we need to clamp the value to 32767 for all the BSD's,
not only macOS.

This work is sponsored by The FreeBSD Foundation

Add a method to determine if the OS is *BSD

* Add an isBSD() method to match isLinux(), etc.  This can be used in a
  test that requires specific OS handling.
